fields.title: Replace RowIDs
fields.description: If selected the RowIDs will be replaced

fields.title: Replacement mode
fields.description: Replace the RowID by a newly generated one or the values of a column.

fields.title: ID column
fields.description: The column to replace the current RowID.
fields.choicesNote: варианты появятся, когда к узлу подключена входная таблица

fields.title: Remove selected ID column
fields.description: If selected, the column replacing the current RowID is removed from the table.

fields.title: If ID column contains missing values
fields.description: Fail if encountering missing values, or replace them.

fields.title: If ID column contains duplicates
fields.description: Fail if encountering duplicate values, or make them unique.

fields.title: Enable hiliting
fields.description:
If selected, a map is maintained joining the old with the new RowID. Depending on the number of rows,
enabling this feature might consume a lot of memory.

fields.title: Append column with RowID values
fields.description: If selected, a new column with the values of the current RowID is appended to the table.

fields.title: Column name
fields.description: The name of the column to append to the table.
